page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.2xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark results position the ecs.g7.2xlarge in the average tier for most compute and memory tasks. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests yield scores of 1841.19 and 7764.36 respectively, while Geekbench multi-core performance reaches 6005.0. Memory bandwidth is measured at 426.28 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 59.12 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The instance demonstrates average performance in static web serving at 12.01 GB/sec and software compilation with Clang at 8218.0. However, it exhibits weaker performance in database-related operations, with Redis SET operations scoring 7.99 million operations per second, and poor-to-weak performance in medium-sized (7B) LLM inference tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for standard enterprise workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory or compute-optimized hardware. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average performance across general computing benchmarks, this instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, application servers, software compilation, and light-to-moderate data processing. It is less suitable for memory-heavy databases or large-scale machine learning inference.
